title: About Access Policies for Policy Groups

blocks.text: This feature is in limited availability. To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.

A policy group is a collection of access rules that share the same common criteria. The configured criteria are automatically applied to every rule within the group. The following conditions for common criteria apply:

blocks.item: Each policy group can have its own unique common criteria.
The AND operator is used to logically configure the criteria defined in each rule in the group.
Changes to common criteria automatically affect every rule within that policy group.

blocks.text: Policy groups provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Organize related access rules into logical groups that share common criteria.
Simplify policy management and reduce the number of individual rules you need to maintain.
Improve scalability by grouping applications, business units, or locations under separate policy groups.

blocks.text: Access policies for policy groups help organize application access rules by grouping rules that share common criteria. Instead of managing numerous individual rules, you can organize related rules into logical groups and apply shared criteria. This simplifies policy management and improves scalability across your organization.
Before you enable policy groups, review the following prerequisites and migration considerations:

blocks.item: Ensure that Application Scaling is enabled and that all of its specific prerequisites are fully met. To learn more, see Using Application Scaling.
Have Zscaler Experience Center enabled. To learn more, see What Is Zscaler Experience Center?
Policy groups are only supported for Experience Center.

Ensure that legacy cloud service API automation and workflows for access policies are updated. The legacy Private Access (ZPA) cloud service API calls are not supported for managing policies after global rules and policy groups are enabled. To learn more, see Configuring Policy Groups Using API, Configuring Policy Group Rules Using API, and Configuring Access Policies Using API.

blocks.text: On the Policy Groups page (Private Access > Policy > Access Policy > Policy Groups), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View the page by policy groups or rules.
Add a new policy group.
Modify the columns displayed in the table.
View a list of configured policy groups. For each policy group, you can see:

Group Order: The policy evaluation order number for the policy group. Private Access applies policy rules based on the order they are listed here. Change the rule order by clicking the number and manually entering a new value. Click the group to open a drawer showing its criteria.
Group Name: The name of the policy group.
# of Rules: The number of rules contained in the policy group.
Common Criteria: Indicates whether common criteria are defined for the policy group.
Edit a policy group.
Delete a policy group.
Browse the list of configured policy groups. You can search for a policy group, create additional groups, and view the number of criteria and rules contained in each group.
View existing access policies created in the legacy UI. These policies are automatically moved to default policy groups.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
Go to the Global Rules page to view the global rules configured for your organization.
